note: Gold figures are player and site estimates from the first month of WoW Forever. Prices move every week; check the Auction House before you commit to a farm.

Method: early bags in WoW Forever

milestones.label: Riding and mount at 40
milestones.text: Apprentice Riding comes with a racial mount. Being Honored with the faction you buy from takes 10% off. Paladins and Warlocks get theirs from a class quest instead.

milestones.label: Dual Specialization
milestones.text: Bought from your class trainer. Wait until the mount is paid for.

milestones.label: Fast riding and swift mount at 60
milestones.text: Journeyman Riding is 1,000g (900g at Honored). Some sites list the swift mount as a separate purchase, so plan for about 1,080 to 1,200g in total.

pace.text: About 20g saved by level 30 keeps the level 40 mount in reach without stopping to farm.
90 to 100g at 40 pays for riding the moment you ding.

brackets.focus: Save silver and set up, do not farm yet.
tips: Take two gathering professions now (Skinning plus Herbalism or Mining) and leave crafting until 35 to 40.
Train only the spells you actually press. Skipping filler ranks before 40 saves about 30g.
Park a level 1 bank alt in Orgrimmar or Thunder Bluff. Mail it cloth, herbs, ore, spare greens and empty Waylaid Crates.
Never vendor an empty Waylaid Crate: they sell on the Auction House.
Buy or have made 8 to 10 slot bags early so long quest loops do not end in a bag-full trip.

spots.name: Kolkar centaurs, Lushwater Oasis
spots.text: Linen Cloth while you quest the Oasis.

spots.name: Zephras Isle copper
spots.text: The densest Copper veins around, if you are a miner.

brackets.focus: Quest, gather on the way, run each dungeon once with its quests.
tips: Collect every quest for a dungeon and run it once. Repeating low dungeons without quests pays poorly.
Aim for about 20g in the bank by level 30.

spots.name: Bael'dun Mine
spots.text: Tin, Copper and Silver inside the mine while you clear weak mobs.

spots.name: Hillsbrad farmers and farmhands
spots.text: Steady Wool Cloth while you quest there.

spots.name: Harpy cave
spots.text: Wool, Silk, coin and Vibrant Plumes that vendor for about 8s each.

tips: Bank 90 to 100g by 40 and hold off on Dual Spec until the mount is paid.
Artisan gathering (225 to 300) opens at 35 for about 5g.

spots.name: Elemental Exiles
spots.text: The best farm without professions. Burning Exiles in the north-west first, Thundering Exiles in the centre next. Skip the Rumbling Exiles in the south.

spots.name: Sea-floor Giant Clams
spots.text: Blue Pearls with no combat. They are wanted in sets of 9 for a Badlands quest.

spots.name: Shadow panthers
spots.text: Vendor tails on top of Skinning.

brackets.focus: The best leveling gold. Questing alone pays about 10 to 20g an hour.
tips: Most quests from level 48 up pay gold. Turn them in as you go instead of saving them for 60.

spots.name: Surf Gliders, south shore
spots.text: The best open-world spot of the bracket, more so with Skinning and Mining. Leave the elite Giant Surf Gliders alone.

spots.name: Owlbeasts
spots.text: Giant Eggs, Vibrant Plumes and Cured Ham Steak.

spots.name: Rocs and Fire Rocs
spots.text: A safer Giant Egg loop north of Gadgetzan.

tips: At level 56, do Top of the Post for Sebelia at the Mount Hyjal summit camp (70.8, 51.4). It gives a free 18-slot bag and a useful clasp.

spots.name: Diseased Black Bears
spots.text: The best pre-60 loop with Skinning.

spots.name: Scorching Elementals
spots.text: Essence of Fire and Elemental Fire without any profession.

spots.name: Frostsabers
spots.text: Frostsaber Leather with Skinning, north of Everlook.

habits.text: On the Auction House, match the lowest price for stackable goods instead of undercutting by 1 copper. The newest listing at the lowest price sells first.
If the Auction House price minus the 5% cut is below the vendor price, vendor it.
Never pay more than 50g on the Auction House for Black Lotus, Arcane Crystal and other top materials: the Black Market vendor in Powderfuse Port sells them at that price.
Instances are capped at 5 entries an hour, so plan dungeon farms around about 12 minutes a run.

avoid.name: Blackmaw Hold Devotee AoE
avoid.text: Hotfixed to drop nothing. Repeat farmers lost gold or were suspended.

avoid.name: Zul'Farrak graveyard zombies
avoid.text: Hotfixed to almost no copper or XP.

avoid.name: Vendor crafting shuffles
avoid.text: Vendor prices for wands, oils, elixirs, bandages and bars were cut.

avoid.name: Krol'dok Stronghold cliff-evade AoE
avoid.text: Exploits mob pathing; a likely target for economy locks.
